newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas up again in winter as volumes recover.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas up again in winter as volumes recover.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures prices and volumes bounced back on Thursday after a slow day on Wednesday, as 200 lots were traded at higher prices.

The trades were concentrated, once again, in the winter, with all the deals done between October and February. January saw the biggest rise of the day, up by 0.375 pence a therm to trade at 18.40 pence, after trading earlier at 18.15 pence.
All eight deals done were at higher prices.

By the close only three months, October, March and April had both bids and offers posted. Front month August was bid at 9.25 pence and not offered, while September was offered somewhat surprisingly at 12.60 pence without a bid.
